legal.t1Body: By registering, accessing, or creating an account on the Coworking Pass platform, you explicitly agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and Cookie Policy. If you do not agree to any part of these terms, please refrain from using the platform.
legal.t2a: Universal Pass memberships allow access to all partner workspaces across Saudi Arabia with a single subscription.
legal.t2b1: To prevent double-booking and ensure fair access, pass holders may reserve
legal.t2b2: only one active workspace seat at a time
legal.t2c: System automatically blocks simultaneous overlap reservations. Members can cancel and switch to another location for free.
legal.t3b2cBody1: Free cancellation with 100% refund is guaranteed when cancelling at least
legal.t3b2cBody3: booking start time. Cancellations within 6 hours are non-refundable to maintain partner operations.
legal.t3b2bBody1: Free cancellation with 100% refund for team desk and hall bookings is guaranteed when cancelling at least
legal.t3wallet2: Funds deposited immediately to your account wallet for instant rebooking.
legal.t3card2: Processed to Mada / Visa / Mastercard within
legal.t4earnBody: Earn 10 base points for every 100 SAR spent on pass reservations.
legal.t4redeemBody: Every 100 points equals a 25 SAR cash discount at checkout.
legal.t5Body: Hot desk reservations are strictly individual and non-transferable. Visitors to meeting rooms and private offices must adhere to max capacity limits and register at partner receptions upon arrival.
legal.p0Title: Saudi Arabia PDPL Data Protection Compliance
legal.p0Body: Coworking Pass is committed to safeguarding user personal data in strict compliance with the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL) and National Data Governance policies.
legal.p1a: Account details: Full name, email address, phone number, company CR.
legal.p1b: Usage history: Booking dates, QR check-in timestamps, location logs.
legal.p1c: Technical metadata: IP address, device type, browser session tokens.
legal.p2a: Issuing encrypted QR access passes for partner receptions.
legal.p2b: Processing payments and managing loyalty rewards points.
legal.p2c: Sending critical booking updates and security OTP verifications.
legal.p3Body1: All user data and database records are securely hosted and processed on local cloud infrastructure located
legal.p3Body2: within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
legal.p3Body3: , ensuring national data sovereignty and high cybersecurity standards.
